{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_count}')

# Define the threshold for internal test orders
internal_test_threshold = 999999.99
print(f'Internal test revenue threshold: {internal_test_threshold}')

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != internal_test_threshold)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')"}
